prompt:
以下はある英語ニュースpodcast記事のFull Story・Point One・Point Twoです。
Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は
具体的な理由を明記してください)。

【Full Story】
As of September 2026, a quiet change can be seen in how many young people in Japan talk about travel.

Surveys show that they are interested in traveling at their own speed. They want trips built around a hobby, and more free time during a tour.

This wish appears in several surveys. In one survey of Japanese people aged 19 to 25, about 90% said they wanted free time on an overseas tour. Most of them wanted half a day or more.

But there is a second part to the story.

When people were asked what they would do if they could take a full month off, the most common answer was a trip of about one week. It was chosen by about 24%.

Yet people planning an autumn trip expected to stay only 1.8 nights on average. The middle figure was about 2 nights. A tourism white paper also says that making stays longer is still a policy need.

So this is not a complete move from sightseeing to long, slow travel. It is a gap.

The wish for more personal time is becoming easier to see. But measured travel plans are still short. The question is no longer only what young people want. It is how much of that wish can fit into a real trip.

【Point One】
Age alone does not explain this picture. Among men under 30, solo trips and hobby-focused trips are leading choices. Among women the same age, about 45% still show interest in visiting famous places. So slow travel does not mean sightseeing is disappearing. It can mean different travel goals for different groups. The useful question is which travelers want more control over a trip.

【Point Two】
The key test is not only stated interest. It is whether travel plans become longer. If a month off were possible, “about one week” was the most common answer, at about 24%. But autumn travel planners expected 1.8 nights on average, with a middle figure of about 2 nights. For tourism planners, longer stays—not just interest—are the clearer measure of progress.

point_one.reasoning: 男女別の旅行目的や、ソロ旅行・趣味重視・名所訪問への関心という具体的な差を示し、若者全体を一括りにできない理由を明らかにしている。誰が旅行の自由度を求めているのかという、旅行商品の設計にもつながる示唆があり、Full Storyにはない新しい理解を加えている。

point_two.reasoning: 旅行期間への関心と実際の滞在日数の差を、具体的な数値とともに示し、観光計画では長期滞在が重要だと説明している点で「なぜ重要か」は明確である。ただし、数値も結論もFull Storyですでに提示されており、実質的にはその中心内容の反復で、新しい理解や具体的な追加示唆はほとんどない。
